t.r.a.c.k.s.bio: Toronto producer T.R.A.C.K.S. is a Canadian hip-hop beatmaker and former member of IRS and the Monolith collective whose production work helped shape Scarborough's late-1990s and early-2000s rap scene.

the barr brothers.bio: Montréal-formed The Barr Brothers is a Canadian-American indie-folk band whose layered sound combines Americana, blues, harp, experimental textures and roots songwriting.

the dream warriors.bio: Toronto duo Dream Warriors is a pioneering Canadian hip-hop group whose jazz-sampled 1990 debut And Now the Legacy Begins became one of the country's first internationally successful rap albums.

thrust.bio: Toronto rapper Thrust, born Christopher France, is a Canadian hip-hop veteran best known as one of the MCs on the landmark 1998 Rascalz posse cut Northern Touch.

trp.p.bio: Toronto duo TRP.P, formed by producer Truss and singer-songwriter pHoenix Pagliacci, is a Canadian R&B and hip-hop project known for queer love songs, soul-jazz influence and playful live performances.
